run_bm_interpolate_face_attribues: run the benchmark for interpolate_face_attributes comparing CUDA and Python implementations across multiple parameter combinations
run_bm_forward: run the forward pass benchmark for interpolate_face_attributes with a specific batch size, image size, and feature dimension
